name: Joonho Lee
role: Group Leader, Neuromeka AI Lab · Advisor, RIVR
bio: Robotics researcher and systems integrator with field experience. PhD from the Robotic Systems Lab at ETH Zurich on learning-based locomotion and navigation for legged robots; now leading learning-based control and manipulation for industrial robots at Neuromeka.
